bullets.text: Waymo Raises $16B for Global Expansion - **Waymo** plans to scale its robotaxi fleet to cities like London and Tokyo.
Ikea Launches Playful Speaker - The **Grejsimojs** Bluetooth speaker is designed for kids and priced at £12.00 in the UK.
Linq Secures $20M for Messaging AI - **Linq** aims to integrate AI assistants into messaging apps, enhancing customer communication.
Ring Expands Search Party Feature - **Ring** now allows non-camera owners to use its AI-powered feature to find lost dogs.
Motorola's Budget Phones Lack Updates - The **Moto G17** ships with Android 15, offering only two years of security updates.
Apple Ends iPhone Upgrade Program - **Apple** discontinues its iPhone Upgrade Program in the UK, introducing a new finance option.
Adobe Animate to Shut Down - **Adobe** will discontinue its animation software as it shifts focus to AI technologies.
Notepad++ Hijacked by Hackers - A security breach allowed hackers to deliver malicious updates to **Notepad++** users for months.
Firefox Adds AI Control Feature - **Mozilla** will let users disable AI features in Firefox, catering to diverse preferences.
Grubhub Waives Fees for Large Orders - **Grubhub** eliminates delivery fees on orders over $50 to compete with rivals.
